feat(zigbee2mqtt): let Zigbee2mqtt generate the network settings of new installations

feat(zigbee2mqtt): fall back on the ezsp driver when the dongle firmware is too old for ember
fix(matter): fall back on the default brightness bounds when a light does not expose MinLevel / MaxLevel

releases.name: v5.3.2
highlights: fix(mqtt): ignore empty or null payloads on custom topics instead of storing 0
feat(device): flow-sensor category with the m³/h and m³/s units
Restart external integrations after a backup restored on a new machine

Mark native Nextcloud Talk deprecated

fix: poll discovered external devices with a poll_frequency (#3198)

fix: keep primary, active and danger widget button styles in dark mode (#3153)

releases.name: v5.1.4
highlights: Fix CalDAV sync when event properties have parameters
Limit stored messages to the 1000 most recent per user in the daily purge
fix(caldav): handle "GMT+hhmm" timezones and skip unformattable events (#3144)

releases.name: v5.1.3
